run_release_notes_cli: run the release notes CLI to generate draft and final Markdown release notes from GitHub PRs
get_commit_log: get the git merge commit log between two release tags or branches using git log
get_pr_data: get a single PR's metadata from the GitHub API including labels, title, and merged_by info
get_pr_titles: get all PR titles and labels from git merge logs and categorize them by language and release note status
write_draft: write a draft release notes Markdown file listing PRs by missing labels and inclusion status
